description: This file declares constants, external variables, and function prototypes related to versioning and system information for a software project. It includes declarations for git version strings, user agent functions, and system info retrieval using uname.

methods.name: git_user_agent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string based on the repository version info.

methods.name: git_user_agent_sanitized
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the user agent string.

methods.name: get_uname_info
methods.description: Gathers system information using uname and fills the provided buffer.
